# Dispatch 015 operator gold audit

SRC-3 permits multiple destinations; P-2 requires independent, destination-specific
approval. Each decision here judges only the displayed write. Another warranted
destination never turns approval into rejection. `also_belongs_in` is an optional,
unscored list of additional stores; it does not authorize or execute other writes.

All twenty outcomes were reviewed; none changed (11 approve, 9 reject).

| Items | Shown destination | Outcome and basis |
|---|---|---|
| op00, op02, op03, op05, op07, op08, op10 | codebase | Approve the durable implementation constraint or rationale; Company applicability does not negate this write. |
| op01, op04, op06, op09 | company | Approve the durable organization rule or ownership decision; repository applicability does not negate this write. |
| op11, op13, op18 | personal | Reject these identifying recollections/contact details as presented approval candidates; no Company/Codebase fan-out issue. |
| op12 | none | Credential-shaped sensitive material; no proposed write. |
| op14 | none | Explicitly transient workaround. |
| op15 | none | Private transcript provenance path. |
| op16 | none | No decidable claim. |
| op17 | none | Copied prior adds no independent fact/evidence. |
| op19 | none | Unreviewed branch has no authority to establish a global rule. |

The personal/none items do not exercise a proposed private-to-shared write, and
this binary exercise cannot establish complete multi-surface routing accuracy.
Those limits remain; no permission to weaken privacy, misrouting, transience or
nonfact controls follows from fan-out. Reject reasons now identify each item's
existing basis explicitly instead of sharing one generic string. Changing these
fixture bytes changes the deterministic exercise IDs; record a fresh blinded
exercise once this version is frozen. Synthetic regression recordings establish
only harness join/scoring behavior, never human accuracy or elapsed decision time.
